summary: An on/off switch for a single setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and its accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner control. Does not change with the state.

description.note: Help text under the label, read as the switch's accessible description.

error.note: Error message under the label. Setting it marks the field invalid and blocks form submission.

size.note: Track and thumb size: default 32x20, sm 24x16. Label typography is the same in both.

value.note: Submitted with the form while the switch is on; nothing is submitted while off.

checked.note: On (true) or off (false). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Must be on for the form to submit (native valueMissing). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Cannot be focused or toggled, dimmed, not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor has the same effect without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the switch in the first column; label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Positions the track and thumb over the native input; vertically aligned with the first line of the label.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation. Visually covers the track.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: Pill; off fill, on fill, invalid border.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Circle at the start when off, at the end when on (mirrored in right-to-left).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle by the person. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed by the person; FormData read in the listener already has the new value. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed. Not fired when checked is set from code.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Thumb moves to the end and the track fills; position carries the state, not color alone.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after the person leaves it or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins. formValue: value while on, null while off. formReset: checked returns to the checked attribute. formStateRestore: checked from the restored state. validationAnchor: the inner input (required -> valueMissing; error -> customError). Disabled (own or fieldset) is not submitted. A <label for> pointing at the host toggles it.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (sm 24x16); the label beside it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; does not toggle, SB-0009, SB-0101)

aria: role=switch on the native checkbox; aria-checked is derived from its checked state (true/false, never mixed)
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: on/off state announced by the screen reader on toggle (native role=switch)
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off (notifications, airplane mode, dark mode)
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The effect or consequence of turning it on needs explaining
A dense row, toolbar or table cell
The setting is saved with a form
useCases.use: name (and value if "on" is not what the server expects); the form submits it only while on

useCases.when: The setting must be on before the form can be sent
useCases.use: required, with error to say why

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On"/"Off", "Enabled"/"Disabled")
antiPatterns.why: The switch already announces its state; a changing name makes it unclear what is being turned on (APG switch pattern)
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

antiPatterns.why: A switch is strictly on or off; it has no mixed value (APG switch pattern)

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing several options from a list
antiPatterns.why: Each switch reads as its own setting, not as one choice among a set

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch only has two states

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field and Label parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn's bg-input is neutral-200, below 3:1; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
shadcn uses foreground for the off thumb in dark; background still passes 3:1 on the neutral-500 track and keeps one token
shadcn default is 32x18.4 and sm 24x14; rounded to whole pixels on the 4px grid so the thumb is a whole icon size
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern (native checkbox with role=switch), the visual reference Switch look and sizes, label row beside the switch like Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.recommendation: No, like Checkbox and native defaultChecked.
openQuestions.answer: No. The attribute is the default that form reset restores; checked is a property and both read it at start.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and is there a hide-label option?
openQuestions.answer: Label is required (only reliable accessible name across the shadow boundary). hideLabel is not part of 0.1.0 because it was not asked for; it can be added later with Checkbox's semantics.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG allows it as optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.recommendation: Enter submits the form; Space toggles.
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits, like the native checkbox and sb-checkbox (SB-0009); toggling on Enter would make Enter behave differently in one control of the same form.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes ship?
openQuestions.recommendation: default and sm, the two the visual reference has.
openQuestions.answer: default (32x20) and sm (24x16), from the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens. No lg.

openQuestions.question: Does Switch need the shared option-row mixin the form-associated-controls rule asks the first option row to create?
openQuestions.answer: No. Switch is a direct native-control wrapper like Checkbox (FormAssociated + NativeControl), not a composite option row; that mixin is left to the first checkbox option or radio option.

openQuestions.question: Should the track show on/off text or icons?
openQuestions.answer: No. The thumb position carries the state besides the fill (WCAG 1.4.1), and the visual reference has no text; text in a 32px track would not fit translated labels.
